evidence.R1-01: Packet Round 3 Q4 'If the cancel call times out: no blind resend; re-read the order. Cancelled, continue to refund' applies to any timeout, but round0 line 101 (second CO-A2 unanswered) skips the re-read and goes straight to CO-A4, and CO-S15 line 892 makes every later lookup unanswered.
evidence.R1-02: Row line 96 'changed ... in the confirming turn or after confirming' has no triggering scenario; CO-S03 Turn 2 is 'in place of a confirmation' and its note says 'Turn 2 replaces the order before any confirmation, so it confirms nothing'.
evidence.R1-03: Packet Round 3 Q1 'The agent promises nothing about when the money arrives' appears only in the Scope must-not list (line 49); no CO rule, Forbidden line or dimension in lines 1497-1509 asserts it.
evidence.R1-05: Packet Round 2 Q1 'no time limit'; CO-01 (line 62) gates only on status and no scenario sets an old placed date (only CO-S02 gives 2026-11-03/04).
evidence.R1-06: Every CO-S01 row names an order (lines 155-157) and CO-S02 is the only unnamed case; evaluation-checklist line 20 'test only "asks when unsure" and you get an agent that always asks'.
evidence.R1-07: cockburn-checklist.md line 74 requires a lookup-branching row to cover 'nothing found'; row line 100 branches only on cancelled, placed/processing, shipped/delivered and no answer.
evidence.R1-08: Packet Round 3 Q3 'failed or no refund, hand off and say the refund is not confirmed yet' vs row line 105 and rubric line 1505 requiring 'the refund has not been issued'.
evidence.R1-09: CO-S17 rows (lines 1035-1037) and CO-S20 rows (1206-1207) make the whole final-state line a column, asserting a failed refund in some rows and no refund in others; checklist 'Data variants share the Expected shape'.
evidence.R1-10: Appendix A line 1525 returns 'failure_reason (payment_method_closed, ...)', but the packet's Refund model (Round 2 Q3 plus changes) has only id, order number, amount, payment method, status.
evidence.R1-11: CO-S05 note line 395 'The order is past the cutoff in every row' vs packet Round 2 Q1 'Cancellable while placed or processing, no time limit'.
evidence.R1-12: CO-S02 confirmation pair (line 189) has no scope marker and §5.2 line 1489 says interaction recall is 'never folded into the score', so a lucky guessed proposal passes despite CO-02 'proposes nothing until the customer names one'.
evidence.R1-13: CO-S19/S21 line 1120/1236 'together they create refund RF-5531' leaves open what a CO-A1 between the two unanswered CO-A3 calls returns, while Appendix A line 1519 allows unlimited CO-A1 and Required says 'exactly twice'.
evidence.R1-14: Rubric 'Refund terms explained' (line 1502) requires saying the refund is the total paid, but CO-S09 reference step 3 (line 594) only says 'the refund can only go to the order's payment method' plus the proposal values.
evidence.R1-16: G-04 (line 27) allows repeating whenever 'the order system guarantees that repeating it creates nothing new', which SG-04 (line 1544) satisfies for CO-A2, contradicting CO-06 and packet Round 3 Q4 'no blind resend'.
evidence.R1-17: The line is a countable tool-log condition computable without judgment, and evaluation-checklist line 17 says 'A tool call that only reads is never Required', so the proposed move to Required events is barred and Forbidden is the sanctioned form.
evidence.R2-02: Round0 line 1507 'Refund status reported' requires 'tells the customer the order is cancelled' while row line 105's pending/issued branch only says 'tell the customer that status and the refund id'; the CO-S14/S15 instance is covered by G-03 but the CO-S19 instance stands.
evidence.R2-03: CO-S01 note (round0 line 170) says 'the only check on the agent's words, message check "Refund id reported"', and after the R1-03 fix the same note also names rubric 'No arrival date promised', so the note contradicts itself.
evidence.R2-04: Both CO-S06 rows (lines 432-435) have an issued refund; no scenario has a cancelled order with a failed or missing refund, and CO-07 ('cancelled but its refund is not shown pending or issued') conflicts with packet derivation 'An already cancelled order: the agent reports that and changes nothing.'
evidence.R2-05: Row line 94 'propose nothing until the customer asks to cancel the whole order' is an act-only-when, but CO-S08's only pair is 'No, I'll keep it' and every row forbids CO-A2, so the acting side has no scenario.
evidence.R2-06: CO-S09 rows (lines 587-589) never ask for a different amount, and the 'Whole order only explained' and 'Refund terms explained' dimensions each check only one of the two statements CO-03 requires.
evidence.R2-07: cockburn-checklist.md line 64 lists 'or none (ambiguous match)'; the shipped/cancelled failure rows (lines 92-93) cover only 'the named order', so an unnamed request where the lookup shows no open order has no row.
evidence.R2-08: CO-S08 Initial state (line 504) gives items totalling $44.00 against total paid $53.50 with no shipping or tax, though list_orders returns shipping and tax (Appendix A line 1523).
evidence.R2-10: After the R1-12 fix, CO-S02 still has no Forbidden line or dimension against a premature guessed proposal, and CO-S07's 'Order not found reported' (line 1500) lacks the 'proposes no cancellation' clause that 'Orders unavailable reported' has.
evidence.R2-13: Round0 lines 1035-1036, 1296, 1356 and reference steps 1045/1336/1394 ('failed, card closed') still carry the failure reason that R1-10 removed from the CO-A3 result; the final spec has no 'card closed' or 'failure reason' left.
evidence.R2-14: CO-S03/S04 Turn 2 triggers (round0 lines 248, 308) name 'the agent's first question that proposes cancelling HG-10482', which §5.1 does not define; evaluation-checklist line 39 says 'never "a proposal"'.
evidence.R3-03: G-02 'Any change to a proposal term after confirmation voids that confirmation' and row line 96 'or another proposal term'; CO-S03's rows only change the order, and CO-S09's term requests come in Turn 1 before any proposal. Final spec had to add CO-S28.
evidence.R3-04: issue_refund returns amount and payment_method (Appendix A), CO-08 guarantees both, and cockburn-checklist line 66 lists 'the supporting actor answers wrongly'; the CO-A3 rows (lines 102-105) branch only on status, errors and timeout.
evidence.R3-05: §5.1 line 1461 'A question with the right form and one wrong value is not the confirmation question'; CO-S03's only pair is HG-10511, so the HG-10482 proposal never fires a Turn 2 bound to 'the agent's first confirmation question', and CO-S04 has 'User knows: none'.
evidence.R3-06: No clause says which agent messages count as 'proposing', yet the dimensions check it ('Before Turn 2, the agent proposes cancelling no order'); the final spec had to add 'asks the customer to approve cancelling ... is not a request for approval' (final lines 1741, 1753).
evidence.R3-07: CO-07 (line 80) 'tells the customer store staff will follow up once the order system has created the task' supports two readings, and under reading (b) an agent obeying it alongside its first CO-A4 fails CO-S23's 'never says ... that staff will follow up' (line 1509).
evidence.R3-09: CO-S01 Initial state (line 119) gives HG-10511 no line items, but row 2's Turn 1 (line 156) says 'I ordered the wrong candles', so the harness has to invent the items.
